responses: Existing TAR UMT students can apply for a Vehicle Entry Pass (VEP) for one car or motorcycle via the intranet (www.tarc.edu.my). Car passes are allocated through computer balloting and cost RM 240 + SST per year (non-refundable), while motorcycle passes are free. Successful applicants can pay via Public Bank, JomPAY, or the Bursary counter, and collect their pass at the Department of Security (TA143, Arena). Selling, buying, or transferring entry passes to third parties is strictly prohibited. Students with a valid VEP enjoy free parking at designated open-space areas.
